## Summary / Tóm tắt thay đổi

### 🇺🇸 English
- Brief description of the motivation and changes in this Pull Request.
- Fixes #(issue-number) if applicable.

### 🇻🇳 Tiếng Việt
- Tóm tắt ngắn gọn mục đích và những thay đổi trong Pull Request này.
- Liên kết tới Issue liên quan nếu có: #(số-issue).

---

## Type of Change / Loại thay đổi

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (updates to README, docs, or guides)
- [ ] 🎨 Code style / Refactor (formatting, renaming, structure without behavioral changes)

---

## Verification & Testing / Kiểm tra & Thử nghiệm

- [ ] Code compiles without errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] TypeScript lint passes without warnings (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Tested in browser with sample file data
- [ ] Conflict detection and collision highlighting verified
- [ ] Responsive UI verified on mobile and desktop viewports
